band_source: naive_flat_hold conformal PI (headline.lower/upper), calibrated on the last 30 backtest folds' next-trading-day (h=1) naive errors (ADR 022)
note: Recalibrated 2026-07 from h=5 to h=1 (ADR 022, fix landed 2026-07-17). This figure counts ONLY decisions made on/after 2026-07-18 (min_decision_date) -- pre-fix decisions were generated under the old, wrong-horizon band and are excluded rather than averaged in, which is what inflated the all-time figure to ~97% for months. n is small and growing slowly (one new decision per day); resolvable_at_n (Wilson 95% CI vs nominal_pct) tells you honestly whether n is large enough yet to say anything statistically.
